<function name="SetNextSecondaryFire" parent="Weapon" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets when the weapon can alt-fire again. Time should be based on <page>Global.CurTime</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="time" type="number">Time when player should be able to use secondary fire again</arg>
	</args>
</function>
